title: Time Value of Money (TVM) - computing Present Value (for the CFA Level 1 exam)
description:
Time Value of Money - computing Present Value (for the CFA Level 1 exam) explores the steps needed to calculate the PV using the Texas Instruments BA II Plus calculator.

This video references:
